title: Possible SQL Injection Against Login Endpoint
raw_alert: Web server logs from APP-WEB-01 show repeated requests from 198.51.100.23 to /login?user=admin' OR '1'='1&pass=test. Several requests returned HTTP 500, followed by a request to /admin/export at 2026-05-29T09:42:11Z. The affected service is the student portal staging environment.
